ai_synthesis.executive_summary: Multiple scenarios passed functional automation (Maestro execution), but high-severity visual defects were detected across all advertisement placements by Screenshot AI. Internal ad SDK debug and technical log messages are visible to end users across all core ad units (Sticky, Article, and Homepage), indicating a significant configuration or integration issue. Several general regression scenarios failed outright during Maestro execution, pointing to functional instability that goes beyond visual/UI problems. No significant dynamic-content or device-specific visual noise was detected; all findings are strongly tied to real defects impacting end user experience and/or business requirements.
ai_synthesis.release_recommendation: Do NOT release. Major, reproducible ad SDK debug information leakage and multiple functional regression failures require urgent remediation before release.
